name: openmic
description: Free open mic sign-up system for Melbourne venues

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute openmic --local --file=./schema.sql && npm run db:migrate:local
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute openmic --remote --file=./schema.sql && npm run db:migrate:remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute openmic --local --yes --file=$f || true; done
scripts.db:migrate:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute openmic --remote --yes --file=$f || true; done
